speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; can you tell me exactly how old your baby is in days or weeks, and how long has this difficulty breathing been going on?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity.

Given the infant's history of being born at 33 weeks and presenting with respiratory distress within two hours of birth, I suspect RDS. I am requesting a Chest X-Ray to confirm this diagnosis and to look for the characteristic ground-glass appearance and air bronchograms. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
